# Advanced Database

Free focused revision pack. Suggested time: 45 minutes.

Query design, concurrency, distributed data and Hadoop.

Attempt every question before opening the answers. These are supplementary exercises, not a complete syllabus or an official exam.

## Question 1

## Question 2

## Question 4

## Question 5
